summary: Accumulates angular momentum and force contributions from constraint rows across three body groups (wheel, suspension, constraint). Each group reads per-body state entries from a shared state vector pointer (this+0x2C) and applies scaled 3D vectors into paired body force/impulse accumulator slots via AccumulateAngularMomentum and F_3DVectorSubtractWithCrossProduct.

operations.description: Wheel group: enter when wheel body count this[2] (this+0x8) is greater than 0
Iterate wheel bodies in the array this[3] (this+0xC) with stride 48; for each body, resolve its constraint id at +8 and use it to index the state vector this[11] (this+0x2C) to build a 3D vector
AccumulateAngularMomentum(body, body+24, vector) per wheel body (0x00569AD0)
F_3DVectorSubtractWithCrossProduct(body, body+24, vector) per wheel body (0x00569B70)
Suspension group: enter when suspension body count this[4] (this+0x10) is greater than 0

Iterate suspension bodies in the array this[5] (this+0x14) with stride 48; combine state vector entries (this+0x2C) with per-body coefficient rows (offsets 72/80/88/96/104/112) and accumulate the weighted result into a body force slot at +332, subtracting the paired weighted result from the partner body force slot
Constraint group: scale the state vector entry (this+0x2C) by constraint coefficients (offsets 64/72/80) to form the applied impulse vector
Iterate constraints in the array this[7] (this+0x1C) with stride 72 while the index is below the constraint count this[6] (this+0x18)
AccumulateAngularMomentum(body, constraint+24, scaled vector) per constraint (0x00569AD0)
F_3DVectorSubtractWithCrossProduct(body, body+24, scaled vector) per constraint (0x00569B70)
